audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart (phases[].side) says Galio wins Levels 1-3 and it's Skill from 4-5 onward, but the content layer (win[] + whys[]) says the opposite: Skill/even for 1-3, Galio ahead 4-5/6/1st item, Sona ahead at 2+ items. The two layers on Sona's own page contradict each other.
audit.why: Content whys[] are grounded in real kit facts (Q range vs his short Justice Punch, his W taunt lock, Hero's Entrance chain CC, late aura/Crescendo scaling) and are internally consistent with win[]. The full-layer why text is a generic template identical across every enemy in this file, so it carries no real signal and is the side that's wrong.
audit.corrected: Set phases[].side to match win[]: Skill, Skill, Skill, Galio, Galio, Galio, Sona — and rewrite each why to state the actual reason instead of the template line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Power spikes were misattributed by the stale chart: Galio's real spike window is his taunt-chain (Justice Punch into Shield of Durand) online at levels 4-6 and first item, not levels 1-3.
audit.why: Galio has no engage before he can walk you down; before level 4 his short E range and lack of a completed W means the lane is a poke war you win with Hymn of Valor's longer range.
audit.corrected: Moved the Galio-favoured window to Levels 4-5 / Level 6 / First item; kept Levels 1-3 even and 2+ items to Sona.

audit.why: Justice Punch (E) is a dash-knockup that can be denied by terrain/grounding, and Shield of Durand (W) is a taunt+shield that changes all-in math — both already correctly flagged in the breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull text.

edits.before: Q-chord the contacts — the aura poke is quiet and constant; the lane pays per note.
edits.after: Q-chord at range: your Hymn out-ranges his short Justice Punch, so poke stays even.

edits.before: W answers the trades: the sustain mirror opens and yours compounds.
edits.after: W answers his walk-up: no taunt yet, so trades stay skill-based.

edits.before: Full kit: the chord colors decide trades — power chord the carry, speed the disengage.
edits.after: Full kit, still even: disciplined max-range poke denies his short Justice Punch.

edits.before: Aura economy: chip, heal, speed — the margins are invisible and decisive.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 tilt Galio: his taunt-into-burst and W tankiness win extended trades.

edits.before: Crescendo online — grouped lanes pay the dance tax; your duo's all-in has a stage.
edits.after: Level 6 favours Galio: Hero's Entrance plus his taunt chain out-engages Crescendo.

edits.before: First item: the auras compound and the chords chunk.
edits.after: First item favours Galio: durable flash-engage.

edits.before: Late Sona scales into a one-button teamfight: crescendo the clump and aura the cleanup.
edits.after: 2+ items flip it: your stacked auras and teamfight Crescendo out-value his single-target dive.
